messages:
maria: Hi team — running into a production issue: with python SDK 0.12.4/0.12.5 an out-of-band replay after a client ReadTimeout re-sends a POST without my Idempotency-Key and creates a duplicate resource.

lee: ouch. can you paste a tiny repro and logs?

maria: minimal repro (httpx Async):
```py
async with AsyncClient() as client:
    headers = {"Idempotency-Key": str(uuid4())}
    try:
        await client.post('/v1/items', json={'name': 'widget'}, headers=headers, timeout=4.0)
    except httpx.ReadTimeout:
        # client gave up; our replay-controller later retries the request
        pass
```
staging traces: client timed out, then replay-controller retried ~1s later and server created item twice.

tony: thanks. quick diagnosis: in-retry path and replay path use different request representations. The in-retry path preserves user headers and normalizes them; the replay path serializes a Request object and reconstructs it later which dropped custom header casing and, in some cases, omitted the header entirely.

infra-bot: logs: [1781234611] ReadTimeout at edge-proxy; [1781234619] replay-controller triggered; backend created resource id=xyz789 on the replay attempt.

lee: proposals:
- always preserve user-provided idempotency header (case-insensitive) across retry + replay flows
- normalize header keys consistently (lowercase) when storing/serializing requests
- add explicit client config: `replay_on_client_timeout` (default: false) and `replay_allow_statuses` (default: [500,502,503,504])
- ensure replay uses exponential backoff + jitter and respects `auto_replay_max`.

maria: also calling out that 409/4xx client-abort (499/408) should not auto-replay. we should document which statuses are considered safe.

tony: + a DX/typing improvement: expose RetryPolicy as a typed dataclass in the public API so users can compose policies (max_attempts, backoff_base, jitter, statuses) and pass per-endpoint overrides when building a Client.

qa: can we add a unit that fakes httpx.ReadTimeout and asserts backend is hit once when Idempotency-Key set? integration test against staging would be great too.

tony: opening PR #2390 with changes: deep-copy headers on serialize/deserialize, normalize keys, preserve Idempotency-Key case-insensitively, config flags, and tests (unit + staging integration). link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2390

maria: verified PR on staging — my repro no longer creates duplicates when Idempotency-Key is present. workaround before patch: set `client.default_headers['Idempotency-Key'] = uuid4()` or create client with `replay_on_client_timeout=False`.

lee: we'll also add a docs note in the SDK guide about non-idempotent endpoints and recommend explicit idempotency keys for POSTs that mutate state.

qa: regression tests added to CI. closing the loop — thanks all :white_check_mark:
